title: The Colony That Vanished Without a Trace
description: In 1590, English settlers returned to Roanoke and found the colony deserted. The word CROATOAN was carved into a post, but the settlers' fate remains uncertain.

scenes.narration: An English ship returned to Roanoke after years away.
